name: Redridge and Crossroads restored quests: the map marks each objective area and the turn-in
contract: The eleven Redridge quests of rev_20261010_98_coa_redridge_restore.sql (254067-254071, 255111-255114, 255116, 255117) and the six Crossroads quests of rev_20261010_98_coa_crossroads_quests.sql (255078-255083) had no quest_poi rows, so the world map drew nothing for them. This case sends the CMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY a real client sends for each quest in the log and reads SMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY_RESPONSE: every quest must answer with one marker per objective area, on the Redridge Mountains (WorldMapAreaId 36) or Barrens (11) map, followed by the turn-in pin (ObjectiveIndex -1) on its ender. A control query for 17003, which the character does not carry, must come back empty.
